info.title: Cairn API
info.description: The Cairn JSON API. Loopback only, no auth, no CORS; a write carrying a foreign Origin is refused.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Latest Revision made in this Session.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Latest Revision made by this author.

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: Only Artifacts with at least one open Thread.

parameters.name: older_than
parameters.description: Only Artifacts last updated longer ago than this: `30d`, `12h`, `90m`, `45s` or `2w`.

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Absolute path of the Project's main checkout.

parameters.name: worktree
parameters.description:
Absolute path of a linked Worktree: shows the Project root's Artifacts
plus that Worktree's, as the CLI does from inside one. Needs `project`
or `project_root` to say which Project it belongs to, else 400.

400.description: Malformed query string, path segment or id.

404.description: No such Artifact, Revision or file.

409.description:
An `edit` against a stale Revision (`base_revision` is not the latest);
the detail names the latest Revision and its author. No read returns it.

422.description:
Well-formed but refused: a limit out of range, an ambiguous or missing
Section, a Kind without Sections.

500.description: Anything else, including a database busy past its timeout.

get.summary:
Threads of an Artifact, with their replies. With `wait`, holds the request
until a Comment newer than the cursor appears or the wait ends; a timeout
is a 200 with no Threads and the same `highest_comment_id`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only Threads holding a Comment with a larger id.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description:
Long poll: seconds to wait for a Comment newer than `since` (or, with
no `since`, newer than the highest id when the request arrived).
`true` or an empty value waits 60; a number is clamped to 300; absent,
`false` or `0` answers at once.

get.summary:
Raw bytes of one stored file, with its stored media type. Always an
attachment with `nosniff`: rendering untrusted bytes is the content
origin's job, never this route's.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Stored file path; may contain slashes

parameters.name: section
parameters.description:
Markdown only: return just this Section, as the CLI's `get --section`
resolves it (`A > B`, optional `#n`).

200.description: The file's bytes. `Content-Type` is the stored media type (`text/markdown` for a Section); `Content-Disposition: attachment` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` are always set.

body.description: The Comment text, at most 64 KiB.

lines.description: Anchor to a line range of a text Artifact: `a-b` or `a`.

reply.description: Root Comment id of the Thread to reply in; takes no `lines`/`section`.

revision.description: Comment on this Revision instead of the latest.

section.description: Anchor to a markdown Section (`A > B`).

thread_id.description: The root Comment's id: the Comment's own id for a root.

ArtifactDetail.description: One Artifact: its list row plus what a list leaves out.

ArtifactList.description: What `list` prints on the CLI and `GET /api/v1/artifacts` returns.

EmbedList.description: What `embeds` prints on the CLI and `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/embeds` returns.

FileEntry.description: One stored file of a Revision, without its bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

bytes.description:
Sum of the sizes of the distinct blobs any Revision of the Artifact
references: what the Artifact costs in the database file.

format.description: Diagram format (`mermaid` or `svg`); null for other Kinds.

Outline.description: What `outline` prints on the CLI and `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/outline` returns.

bytes.description: Byte length of the Section, children included.

Problem.description: The body of every error response.

code.description:
Stable identifier shared with the CLI: `usage`, `not_found`,
`rejected_input`, `conflict` or `unexpected`.

detail.description: The message the CLI prints for the same failure.

type.description: Always `about:blank`: the status and `code` carry the meaning.

RawBytes.description: Schema stand-in for a raw file body.

RefBody.description: Body of a successful create or edit.

ResolvedEmbed.description: One `cairn:` image reference of a markdown Revision, resolved at call time.

dangling.description: The target Artifact or pinned Revision no longer exists.

format.description: The target's diagram format; null unless it is a diagram.

kind.description: The target's Kind; null when dangling.

line.description: 1-based line of the reference in the stored markdown.

pinned.description: Whether the reference named its Revision (`id@N`) rather than latest.

target_revision.description:
The pinned N, or the target's current latest Revision for an unpinned
reference (the rule the web UI uses). Null when dangling.

RevisionManifest.description: A Revision as a file manifest.

stale.description: The Comment's Revision is not the Artifact's latest.

UploadForm.description: Schema of the multipart body of create and edit.

files.description:
Every other part is a file; its part name is its stored path.
A single-file Artifact takes one; an html Bundle takes one or more.

meta.description: Optional on edit, required on create.

WriteMeta.description: The `meta` part of a create or edit. Unknown fields are a 400.

addresses.description: Edit only: root Comment ids of Threads this Revision addresses.

base_revision.description: Edit only: refuse with 409 unless this is still the latest Revision.

format.description: Create only, required for a diagram and refused otherwise: `mermaid` or `svg`.

name.description:
Create only: display name, and the stored path of a single-file
Artifact. Defaults to the file part's name when there is one file part.

project_root.description: Create only: absolute path of the Project's main checkout.

worktree.description: Create only: absolute path of a linked Worktree.
